title: Messaging — Mux Grant — payload
description: Store or replace grants: each a grant statement in which a member DID, with an embedded Data Integrity proof, delegates to a principal the carrying of its messages, under the member's current epoch and an explicit scope and expiry. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

grants.description: The grant statements to store; the member DID is each statement's `issuer`. Each is checked and answered on its own; the batch is never all-or-nothing.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Grant — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/grant request: one outcome per submitted grant, in request order. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/grant/0.1#response.

GrantOutcome.title: GrantOutcome
GrantOutcome.description: The outcome for one submitted grant.

grantId.description: The grant's identifier, from its statement.

principal.description: The principal DID, from the statement.

code.description: Present exactly when `status` is `refused`: the first check the grant failed, in the order the specification lists them.

currentEpoch.description: Present exactly when `code` is `messaging/mux/grant:epochMismatch`: the member DID's current epoch, under which the member re-signs.

replayFloorAt.description: Present exactly when `code` is `messaging/mux/grant:replayed`: the instant a replacement grant's `iat` must be strictly later than — the principal's replay floor for this member, or the `iat` of the grant it would replace, whichever is later.

replacedGrantId.description: Present when this grant replaced an earlier grant for the same member and principal, in whatever state that grant was. Replacing raises the principal's replay floor, so the replaced statement can never be stored again.

attachedNow.description: Present exactly when `status` is `stored`: whether the member was attached at once to a connection the principal holds.
